Tell me about the Wegovycare role

source: TomBot NOVO.R1

Senior Product Manager at Novo Nordisk (Mar 2020 - Feb 2022), building Wegovycare - a retention-focused digital service to increase repeat prescriptions for Wegovy.

I led the full product lifecycle end to end, but it was really a stealth transformation project, where I could bring my learnings from LEO but this time to in-house transformation.

Key achievements:

  • Led the full product life-cycle, introducing discovery, rapid prototyping, iterative development, and automated documentation to the organisation.
  • Automated documentation and shifted release cycles from yearly to bi-monthly in high-regulation environment, enabling iterative learning.
  • Built a weight-loss prediction algorithm from concept to prototype (later spun out into a new API product)
  • Achieved 10% penetration in our first national market

I was asked to scale these learnings across the product organisation and was promoted to Associate Product Director.

Direct answers

  • Patient interviews surfaced two insights: every patient's journey is different, but everyone wants to know the same things - how much weight will I lose, is this normal, am I on track. Those three questions became the core loop, and the weight-loss prediction model answered the first.
  • The brief I was given in my final-round interview was solution-first: a set of standalone features the business thought would help. Nobody had spoken to patients.
  • Through research identified every user-journey is different. Built risk-profiling engine combining clinical data, usage signals, & PROMs to identify drop-off risks.
  • Applied consumer marketing playbook to act on risks, personalising experience for each patient. Built profiling and customisation engine to create an interactive magazine.
  • Digital patient platform for obesity medicine, built to scale. Designed for scaling: modular architecture, feature flags, integrated CMS & translation pipeline, and systematised cocreation with markets.
  • First digital Novo product to successfully scale. Made Novo's first digital health product adopted by multiple markets.
  • Led cross-functional team of 10. Set vision, implemented OKRs & used qual-quant signals to steer priorities and shape the roadmap.
  • Identified a key growth lever. Created a weight-loss prediction model in Excel, now spun-out to a Bayesian API service.
  • Title: Senior Product Manager; the internal title was Product Owner. Same role.

source: TomBot NOVO.R1, Direct answers

How did you change ways of working at Novo?

source: TomBot NOVO.R1.TRANSFORM

Innovation Labs are an interesting idea, but unfortunately rarely work in practice. I still believed there was enormous potential in healthcare, so this time wanted to try it from the inside - transformation by doing.

I got my first opportunity in my final round job interview at Novo, when I convinced the business to set-aside their solution-first brief, and to talk to patients and start with the problem instead. I was fortunate enough to be offered the role, and use this as a mandate to completely reinvent their ways of working. We were the first product team to interview patients, run discovery, make prototypes, co-create with markets and so on. It wasn't straight-forward and took persuasion and a leap of faith from our stakeholders, but the results spoke for themselves.

I was asked to scale these learnings across the product organisation and was promoted to Associate Product Director.

Direct answers

  • Borrowed an anthropologist from another division & proved the value. It later became the Insights team.

source: TomBot NOVO.R1.TRANSFORM, Direct answers
